title: Right derived functors identify triangles of termwise split K-injective sequences
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex], and let F:A\to B be an additive functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive] with unbounded right derived functor RF constructed from K-injectives [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Let 0\to I_1\to I_2\to I_3\to0 be a degreewise short exact sequence of cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] in A which is split in every degree, with each I_i K-injective. Then the distinguished triangle in D(A) attached to this sequence by its canonical connecting morphism [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] is carried by RF to a distinguished triangle canonically isomorphic, through the maps induced on the represented complexes, to the triangle attached in D(B) to the degreewise short exact sequence 0\to F(I_1)\to F(I_2)\to F(I_3)\to0; in particular RF carries the connecting morphism of the first sequence to the connecting morphism of the image sequence under these identifications.
